source.section: PA-40 lines 1a to 12 (form pages 1-2); PDF page 1 and form line 12 rate 3.07 percent; PDF page 9 no standard deduction or exemptions; PDF page 20 Lines 9 and 10; PDF page 21 Lines 11 and 12; PDF page 14 Line 2; PDF page 31 'PA-taxable income includes interest from' and 'does not include interest from'; PDF pages 31-32 Schedule A Lines 6 and 7; projection: us_obligation_interest is not_modelled, so Treasury interest is taxed

worked: U.S. Treasury interest: exempt on the form, taxed by the projection, which cannot tell it from other interest. Federal AGI = wages person 0 50,000.00 + U.S. Treasury interest 20,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 54,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Pennsylvania, as the projection works it: start federal AGI 70,000.00; income after reliefs = 70,000.00. No standard deduction or exemption (PDF page 9), no Line 10 deduction: state taxable income 70,000.00. Tax = 70,000.00 x 0.0307 = 2,149.00. No credit in the projection; state income tax 2,149.00. Form: Line 1a/1c 50,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 5 0.00; Line 9 50,000.00; Line 10 0.00; Line 11 50,000.00; Line 12 1,535.00. Schedule SP: Eligibility Income 70,000.00 is over 8,750.00, so no Tax Forgiveness on the form either. The form leaves the 20,000.00 out (Schedule A Line 7): its tax is 1,535.00, 614.00 under the projection's 2,149.00 (the approximation's own example). Expected follows the projection.
accepted_approximations: Pennsylvania has no federal starting point: it adds the positive amounts of eight classes (compensation, interest, dividends, business, gains, rents, estates and trusts, gambling). The mapping runs from federal AGI to those classes: start from federal AGI, then take out what the reliefs below exempt. Wages, interest, dividends, gains, business income and rents are taken as federal AGI holds them, in one sum. The differences that remain are listed one by one in the next four entries.
Interest on direct U.S. obligations is taxed here (not_modelled entry).
